items.information: If you want to register this competition and have a question, please send an e-mail to kansai@jrca.cc.  Registration Fee: 500Yen for each additional event.  Registration will be closed on June 4 ,2013.

items.information: Registration will open on this site at 7pm on Tuesday 30th April.rnThe will be a limit of 50 competitors.  You may only compete in FM OR MultiBLD.  Please see the website for more details

items.name: Raleigh Open 2013
items.information: The cost of registration will be $12 plus $1 for each additional event for registration in advance and $15 plus $1 for each additional event at the door. This will be used to pay for the venue. Pre-payment via PayPal is required in order to register in advance. Please register early so we now how many people to expect.
